about: Corrections to @2003scape/rsc-data rows, applied once at require time by data-fixes.js. Every entry needs a source (Open-RSC Core-Framework Java file and line, or the live evidence). file is the rsc-data json (skills/cooking = node_modules/@2003scape/rsc-data/skills/cooking.json); path is dot separated, numbers index arrays. ops: set (assign value), delete (remove the key), push (append each of values that is not already there). test/rsc-data-sanity.test.js fails when an entry no longer differs from the raw rsc-data row, so a fix that rsc-data adopts gets removed.
